# 易緯是類謀

**ID:** KR1a0169
**Custom ID:** ZB1a0166
**Source:** 四庫全書 文淵閣版, V53.10, p903
**Extent:** 1 卷

## Authors / Editors
- 鄭玄 (漢朝) 註

**Editions:** WYG

## Summary (Ask Bunkankun 聞分館君)

The seventh of the eight *Yì wěi* 易緯 texts gathered as appendix to the *Yì*-class of the *Sìkù quánshū*; see [KR1a0163](https://ask.bunkankun.org/KR1/KR1a/KR1a0163) for the broader contextualization. One juàn. The work treats *shì lèi móu* — divinatory stratagem-applications classified by-category — as a divinatory-cosmographic apparatus complementary to the *Tōng guà yàn* ([KR1a0167](https://ask.bunkankun.org/KR1/KR1a/KR1a0167)) and the *Jī lǎn tú* ([KR1a0164](https://ask.bunkankun.org/KR1/KR1a/KR1a0164)).

**Abstract**

The work is one of the more compact members of the *Yì wěi* corpus. The substantive content concerns divinatory-stratagem categorization. The Zhèng Xuán-commentary attribution is conventional and not secure.
